Own app/api.py (every ledgerd endpoint from the Endpoints table: / and web/* static serving with correct content types, GET /api/health, GET /api/payments with limit/offset/status/currency/sort returning {data,total,limit,offset}, GET /api/payments/<id> with 404 envelope, GET /api/summary, GET /api/buckets, POST /api/sync returning {fetched,inserted,updated,total}, POST /api/payments/<id>/note returning {id,note,version}, GET /api/events (auth-gated) with after/limit and latest_seq, GET /api/outbox/status with pending/delivered/last_delivered_seq/notifier up|down, GET /api/notifications proxied to notifierd — 502 envelope code 'notifier_unreachable' when unreachable), app/webhooks.py (POST /api/webhooks/meridian: register http://127.0.0.1:<ledger-port>/api/webhooks/meridian with the vendor AFTER ledgerd is bound and listening, idempotent by URL, retried until the vendor is reachable; answer the unsigned webhook.verify challenge handshake with 200 echoing the hex; verify signed events per the docs; duplicate and stale webhook outcomes land in counters, never as events), app/drafts.py (the frozen draft state machine draft → submitted → approved|rejected, and approved → sent once the vendor accepts the payment; creating real vendor payments on the approve/send path; payment.sent ledgered with its outbox row in one transaction; implements D2 as documented in DECISIONS.md, owned by the web-console slice), app/auth.py (three bearer tokens from --tokens-file; Authorization: Bearer on every drafts endpoint and /api/events; missing/unknown token → 401 'unauthorized', known token wrong role → 403 'forbidden'; admin reads everything — drafts, events — and writes nothing). Also owns the two data-contract sections assigned here: GET /api/viz/records (full collection, columnar, one fetch — count plus id/amount_minor/currency/status/created_at/day/version arrays all length N, initial order created_at instant ASC then id ASC, day server-computed Europe/Berlin YYYY-MM-DD so the frontend never recomputes it) and GET /api/stream (SSE text/event-stream, concurrent subscribers, every committed payment-state change reaches a connected subscriber in exactly one message, each message one atomic batch with per-connection monotonically increasing batch numbers, initial dataset comes from /api/viz/records never from replay). Every error uses the single structured envelope {error:{code,message,field_errors}} with field_errors only on 400 and the frozen code vocabulary required|not_an_integer|not_positive|unsupported|too_long|bad_format. Cross-refs: state changes here append to the ledger/outbox owned by the core slice; the frontend consumes these contracts (owned by web-console and web-viz slices).
